overview_description.description: Stepful is an online learning platform that provides training programs for entry-level healthcare careers such as medical assistant, pharmacy technician, dental assistant, and related roles. It delivers its courses through live, instructor-led virtual classes, interactive assignments, and structured exam preparation for nationally recognized certifications. The platform also includes in-person clinical or externship components arranged through partner healthcare providers to help students gain practical experience. Stepful supports learners with additional services such as career coaching, resume preparation, and job search assistance after certification. Overall, it is designed to help students transition into healthcare roles by combining online instruction with hands-on training and employment support.

about_short_description.short_description: Stepful is an online platform offering training and certification for various healthcare jobs.

product.name: Medical Assistant Program
product.description: A 4-month online training program preparing students for the Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) certification, including 80 clinical hours and job coaching.

product.name: Pharmacy Technician Program
product.description: A 4-month online course preparing students for Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) certification, including 130 clinical hours and job coaching support.

product.name: Medical Administrative Assistant Program
product.description: A 3-month fully online program preparing students for the Certified Medical Administrative Assistant (CMAA) certification with no clinical hours required and job support services.
